inputs.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get per year?

outputs.reference_answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues monthly at 2 days per month.

evidence.quote: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
Leave accrues monthly at 2 days per month.

inputs.question: What is the maximum hotel rate per night in New York?

outputs.reference_answer: Hotel rates in New York are capped at 260 USD per night (the same cap applies to London, San Francisco, Singapore and Tokyo; other cities are capped at 180 USD per night).

evidence.quote: Hotel rates are capped at 180 USD per night in standard cities and 260 USD per night in New York, London, San Francisco, Singapore, and Tokyo.

inputs.question: What is the maximum size of a single object in Acme Cloud Storage?

outputs.reference_answer: A single object can be up to 5 TB. Uploads larger than 100 MB should use multipart upload.

evidence.quote: A single object can be up to 5 TB.

inputs.question: When do new engineers join the on-call rotation, and how much is the on-call stipend?

outputs.reference_answer: New engineers join the on-call rotation after 3 months. On-call shifts last one week and pay an extra stipend of 200 USD per shift.

evidence.quote: New engineers join the on-call rotation after 3 months.
On-call shifts last one week and are paid an extra stipend of 200 USD per shift.

inputs.question: What are the standard working hours under the Work Engagement Policy?

outputs.reference_answer: The standard working hours are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, which may change depending on the project a team member is assigned to. Daily office hours should be 9 hours, with at least 8 effective working hours after excluding breaks.

evidence.quote: The standard working hours for all Team Members are from 10:00 A.M to 7:00 P.M, but this may be subject to change based on the Project to which a Team Member is assigned.
the daily individual Office Hours should be 9 Hours and the effective working hours (after excluding all the breaks) should be a minimum of 8 hours.

inputs.question: I'm on an international business trip and a conference provides my lunch on one day. What meal allowance can I claim for that day, and can I claim the wine I had at dinner?

outputs.reference_answer: The meal allowance for international travel is 75 USD per day. Because one meal was provided, the allowance is reduced by 30 percent, so the claim for that day is 52.50 USD (75 USD minus 30 percent). The wine cannot be claimed: alcohol is never reimbursed.

evidence.quote: The meal allowance is 50 USD per day for domestic travel and 75 USD per day for international travel.
Alcohol is never reimbursed.
If meals are provided (for example at a conference), reduce the allowance by 30 percent per provided meal.

inputs.question: How many unused annual leave days can be carried over, and when do they expire?

outputs.reference_answer: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March; they are used before the new year's days, so they do not expire unused if you take leave before 31 March.

evidence.quote: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year; carried-over days expire on 31 March.
Carried-over days are used first, so they do not expire unused if you take leave before 31 March.

inputs.question: How much paid parental leave do primary caregivers get, and how does the return to work work?

outputs.reference_answer: Primary caregivers receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave, which can start up to 2 weeks before the expected birth or adoption date and must be taken within 12 months of it. On return, employees are offered a phased schedule: 80 percent of hours at full pay for the first 4 weeks.

expected_facts: 80 percent of hours at full pay

evidence.quote: Primary caregivers receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave.
Parental leave can start up to 2 weeks before the expected birth or adoption date.
Parental leave must be taken within 12 months of the birth or adoption.

inputs.question: Compare the annual leave carry-over rule in the Acme Cloud leave policy with the carry-over rule for on-bench team members in the Work Engagement Policy.

outputs.reference_answer: Under the Acme Cloud leave policy, up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year and expire on 31 March. Under the Work Engagement Policy, on-bench team members are not eligible for leave carry forward or encashment of leaves left at the end of a calendar year, and any remaining balance is not carried forward when they are reassigned to a project.

expected_facts: not eligible for leave carry forward

evidence.quote: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over to the next year; carried-over days expire on 31 March.
On-Bench Team Members are not eligible for leave carry forward or encashment of any leaves left at the end of a calendar year.

outputs.reference_answer: The Acme Cloud onboarding guide says laptop and access issues go to the IT desk. Under BigStep's Work Engagement Policy, team members file a ticket on support@bigsteptech.com for system or laptop queries.

inputs.question: What does a new engineer receive on the first day according to the Acme Cloud onboarding guide, and where must newly inducted BigStep team members be during onboarding and initial training?

outputs.reference_answer: On the first day a new Acme Cloud engineer receives a laptop, a security badge and access to the internal wiki. inputs.question: I paid 40 USD for a taxi on a business trip and lost the receipt. What should I do?

outputs.reference_answer: Claims above 25 USD need a receipt, so for the 40 USD taxi you must complete the missing-receipt form. No more than 3 missing-receipt forms are accepted per year.

evidence.quote: Every claim above 25 USD needs a receipt.
Lost receipts: complete the missing-receipt form; no more than 3 per year are accepted.

inputs.question: I want to take 12 consecutive working days of annual leave. How far in advance do I need to submit the request, and how quickly will my manager respond?

outputs.reference_answer: Because the leave is more than 10 consecutive working days, the request must be submitted at least 30 days in advance. The manager approves or rejects the request within 3 working days.

evidence.quote: For leave of more than 10 consecutive working days, submit the request at least 30 days in advance.
Your manager approves or rejects the request within 3 working days.

inputs.question: I'm an on-bench team member at BigStep and I want to resign. Does the standard notice period apply to me?

outputs.reference_answer: No. For an on-bench team member who resigns, the standard notice period of 2 months does not apply. The company may waive the notice period and relieve the team member immediately after receiving the resignation, depending on operational needs.

evidence.quote: In the event that an On-Bench Team Member decides to resign from their position, the standard notice period of 2 months will not be applicable.
The company reserves the right to waive the notice period and may choose to relieve the team member from their duties immediately upon receipt of the resignation

inputs.question: What uptime does the Acme Cloud Storage SLA guarantee, and does that guarantee cover the Archive tier?

outputs.reference_answer: The service level agreement guarantees 99.95 percent monthly uptime for the Standard tier, with service credits issued automatically if the target is missed. The FAQ states this guarantee only for the Standard tier; it does not give an uptime guarantee for the Archive tier.

evidence.quote: The service level agreement guarantees 99.95 percent monthly uptime for the Standard tier.
Service credits are issued automatically if the target is missed.

outputs.reference_answer: Not by default. For flights of 6 hours or longer, premium economy is allowed (economy is standard under 6 hours). Business class is only allowed with written approval from a vice president.
